title: Either is enough
prompt: Shipping is free if the order total is 50 or more, OR if the customer is a member. Return true if shipping is free.
signature: func solve(total: float, is_member: bool) -> bool:
starter:
func solve(total: float, is_member: bool) -> bool:
	return false
hint: or is true when at least one side is true.
solution:
func solve(total: float, is_member: bool) -> bool:
	return total >= 50 or is_member
